notes:
A free desktop companion for your own Codex usage on Windows 10 and 11 (x64).

Download **CodexBuddy-Setup.exe** to install, or **CodexBuddy.exe** for the portable version. Follow the first-run guide and connect your own ChatGPT account with Codex access.

Includes five-hour and weekly allowance, reset countdowns, a tray icon, Ctrl+Alt+C show/hide, corner snapping, optional always-on-top, position lock, and optional usage colors.

This release is unsigned, so Windows may show a publisher warning. SHA-256 checksums are provided in SHA256SUMS.txt.

Independent companion, not affiliated with OpenAI.
